bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
src=d611f2d4edf8414c21ecd1d43336debfe48319b1
target="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/sticker-poll-$src"
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test -f "$target/src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs" && test -f "$target/deploy/Dockerfile" || { echo STK04_STAGED_SOURCE_MISSING; exit 61; }
git cat-file -e "$src^{commit}" || { echo STK04_SOURCE_UNVERIFIED; exit 62; }
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.User}}' create-videobot:local-poll)" = node || { echo STK04_CURRENT_IMAGE_USER_MISMATCH; exit 63; }
token="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$name")"
dbpass="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_db_password"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$name")"
test -f "$token" && test -f "$dbpass" || { echo STK04_SECRET_SOURCE_MISSING; exit 64; }
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || { echo STK04_POSTGRES_NOT_UNIQUE; exit 65; }
user="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'printf %s "$POSTGRES_USER"')"
net="$(docker inspect -f '{{range $k,$v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{println $k}}{{end}}' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d')"
test -n "$user" && test "$net" = deploy_default || { echo STK04_DB_OWNER_UNVERIFIED; exit 66; }
other="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei 'create-videobot|createvdobot|videobot-poll|videobot-telegram' | grep -Fxv "$name" || true)"
test -z "$other" || { echo STK04_OTHER_CONSUMER_EXISTS; exit 67; }
log="$(mktemp /tmp/gace-videobot-build.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -f "$log"' EXIT
if ! docker build --network host --pull=false -f "$target/deploy/Dockerfile" -t create-videobot:poll-candidate "$target" >"$log" 2>&1;then
 echo STK04_IMAGE_BUILD=FAILED
 grep -Ei 'failed|error|denied|network|unavailable' "$log" | tail -n 4 | sed -E 's#https?://[^ ]+#URL_REDACTED#g' || true
 exit 68
fi
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint node create-videobot:poll-candidate -e "import('./src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs').then(()=>process.exit(0)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))" >/dev/null || { echo STK04_RUNTIME_IMPORT_FAILED; exit 69; }
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.User}}' create-videobot:poll-candidate)" = node || { echo STK04_CANDIDATE_USER_INVALID; exit 70; }
docker image tag create-videobot:local-poll create-videobot:poll-rollback
docker image tag create-videobot:poll-candidate create-videobot:local-poll
export VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE="$token"
export VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE="$dbpass"
export GSERVER_POSTGRES_USER="$user"
export GSERVER_POSTGRES_NETWORK="$net"
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" config --quiet || { echo STK04_COMPOSE_CONFIG_INVALID; exit 71; }
if ! docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null 2>&1;then
 echo STK04_COMPOSE_RECREATE_FAILED
 exit 72
fi
sleep 10
if test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null)" != true;then
 echo STK04_CONTAINER_NOT_RUNNING
 docker logs --tail 30 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -E '^CREATOR_[A-Z_]+(=|$)' | tail -n 8 || true
 exit 73
fi
if ! docker logs --tail 100 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$';then
 echo STK04_READY_UNVERIFIED
 docker logs --tail 30 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -E '^CREATOR_[A-Z_]+(=|$)' | tail -n 8 || true
 exit 74
fi
echo STK04_IMAGE_IMPORT=PASS
echo STK04_DM_POLL_RUNNING=PASS
echo STK04_DM_READY=PASS
docker logs --tail 100 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -E '^CREATOR_(DM|GATE|POLL)_' | tail -n 8 || true
